title: CollectDiagnosticsRequest
description: Enables starting collection of the diagnostics. This is an asynchronous API and not expected to block.

endTime.description: The end time (in ISO 8601 format) of the period to collection statistics for.

startTime.description: The start time (in ISO 8601 format) of the period to collection statistics for.

destination.description: This defines where to put the resulting bundle.

caseNumber.description: The CSH case number to associate the bundle.

DiagnosticDestination.description: Destination of the created diagnostics bundle.
